definitionZh: :-moz-last-node CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,它代表任何元素,是某些其他元素的最后一个子节点. 它与: last-child 不同,因为它与后面的(非白空)文本不匹配上一个子元素.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-last-node CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that represents any element that is the last child node of some other element. It differs from :last-child because it does not match a last-child element with (non-whitespace) text after it.
